error.message: Principal 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000 does not exist in the directory 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000. Check that you have the correct principal ID. If you are creating this principal and then immediately assigning a role, this error might be related to a replication delay. In this case, set the role assignment principalType property to a value, such as ServicePrincipal, User, or Group.  See https://aka.ms/docs-principaltype
